control.description-key: FY27 Realignment entry builder (State path). On a saved Realignment, pick the debiting Prioritization, multi-select its Prioritization Funding junctions with per-line move amounts, pick the crediting Prioritization and credit Requirement Funding, and -- when the debit Prioritization is Itemized -- reduce selected Itemized Details to balance the move. Writes book_realignmentitem and book_realignmentdetailreduction rows. Bind to book_newamount on the Realignment form.

property.name: amount
property.description-key: The bound field (book_newamount). The control reads and writes the rest of the record via Web API.
